# hooksmith

> Private. The lifecycle-hook generator, linter, and verifier for Claude Code — the
> "hooks" component of the Energy fleet.

## Documentation

- [README.md](README.md): Overview, quick start, recipe catalog, linter violations
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Directory structure, key concepts, how-to guide
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Operating handbook for agents — build, test, scope boundaries
- [identity/SOUL.md](identity/SOUL.md): Who hooksmith is and what it owns
- [identity/MEMORY.md](identity/MEMORY.md): Hook events reference + recipe catalog

## Core Artifact

- [src/generator.ts](src/generator.ts): `generateHooksBlock()` — emit a hooks block
- [src/linter.ts](src/linter.ts): `lintHooksBlock()` — validate a hooks block
- [src/verify.ts](src/verify.ts): `verifyHooksFire()` — prove hooks fire
- [catalog/recipes.json](catalog/recipes.json): Machine-readable recipe registry

## Notes

- This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org)
- hooksmith is a meta-harness: it improves OTHER harnesses' hook blocks
- The owned artifact is a generator + linter + test harness (TypeScript, no framework deps)
